Personal Trainers

Professional organizations that certify personal trainers include the

American College of Sports Medicine, American Council on Exercise, IDEA

Health and Fitness Association, and National Strength and Conditioning

Association.

Use these websites to find a personal trainer:
www.acsm.org/get-stay-certified/find-a-pro
www.acefitness.org/education-and-resources/lifestyle/find-ace-pro
www. ideafit.com/find-personal-trainer
Pesticides

Protection Agency (EPA), and the Environmental Working Group provide
information about pesticides.
